objective: Design an implementation workflow for a single-file interactive 3D HTML architecture visualization. The visualization should present a layered system with: owner intent/governance, canonical state, code/version state, verified runtime receipts, light boot and active jobs, compute routing, workers, causal/chronicle memory, verification/readback gates, and an information membrane. It must be visually legible, support orbit/zoom/select interactions, expose status/truth-boundary cues, degrade gracefully on mobile, and keep all content generic/public-safe. Do not require private IDs, private topology, raw memory, credentials, or canonical write access.
acceptance_criteria: Propose a clear 3D spatial metaphor and hierarchy that makes system layers and directed relationships understandable.
Use a single self-contained HTML delivery approach with CDN-loaded rendering libraries allowed; include mobile/desktop interaction guidance.
Include node selection details, legend/status encoding, directed edges, filtering/focus controls, and a readable fallback when WebGL is unavailable.
Preserve truth boundaries such as configured != executed, queue accepted != executed, executed != verified done, and Drive state != runtime.
Return a workflow that can be used by a private owner session to implement and validate the artifact without exposing protected data.
falsifier: Reject the design if it requires protected/private source content in the public packet, conflates canonical state with runtime truth, cannot express verification states, or cannot be implemented as a portable HTML file with usable 3D navigation and a non-WebGL fallback.
